description.value:
The spirits of all saints that have come before you bolster you in your time of need.

Radiant Finality. When you cast Compelled Duel on a creature and it fails its saving throw, you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature in addition to the spell’s normal effects. In addition, you can cast Compelled Duel as part of the same Bonus Action used to cast a Paladin spell that has “Smite” in its name and does not require Concentration.

Maker’s Bulwark. Your Consecrated Plate improves. While you are wearing it you gain an additional +2 bonus to your Armor Class.

source.custom: Legends of the Round Table: Chivalric Handbook
